Use MDM to enable Remote Management in macOS
Learn how to control a remote Mac that is managed with Mobile Device Management (MDM).
To control a remote Mac that is managed by Mobile Device Management (MDM), use the Enable Remote Desktop command. The Enable Remote Desktop command turns on Remote Management for all users with the "Observe" and "Control" options enabled.
Need more help?
